strings.sat.desc.iss: Babban tsarin da mutane suke zama a cikinsa a sararin samaniya. Ƴan sararin samaniya suna zama a cikinsa koyaushe, kuma yana kewaya Duniya kowane minti 92 kusan. Yawanci shi ne mafi haske a cikin sararin samaniyar dare.
strings.sat.desc.css: Tashar sararin samaniya ta China, da mutane ke zama a ciki tun 2021. Ya fi karanci girma fiye da Tashar Sararin Samaniya ta Duniya, amma a lokacin wucewa mai kyau, kusan haskensa daidai ne.
strings.sat.desc.hst: Na'urar hangen nesa ta sararin samaniya da aka ƙaddamar a 1990 wacce ta canza abin da muka sani game da sararin samaniya. Ya ɗauki hotunan taurari masu nisa sosai kuma ya taimaka wajen auna yadda sararin samaniya yake faɗaɗa cikin sauri.
strings.sat.desc.acs3: Tauraron dan wuta na gwaji na NASA mai jirgin rana kimanin m² 80, wanda matsin hasken rana kaɗai yake tura shi. Jirginsa mai sheki yana sa shi haske ga girmansa.
strings.sat.desc.envisat: Tauraron dan wuta na Turai don lura da Duniya, girman mota babba (bas). An rasa hulɗa da shi a 2012, kuma tun lokacin yana nan a cikin kewaya a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin manyan sharar sararin samaniya.
strings.sat.desc.amos: Jerin tauraron dan wuta na sadarwa na Isra'ila. Suna a tsawan kusan km 36,000, saboda haka suna kama kamar sun tsaya a wuri ɗaya a sararin samaniya. Ba za a gan su da ido tsirara ba, amma manhajar tana nuna hanyarsu.
strings.sat.desc.eros: Tauraron dan wuta na Isra'ila mai ɗaukar hoto mai inganci sosai wanda ImageSat take gudanarwa, an ƙaddamar a 2022.
strings.sat.desc.venus: Tauraron dan wuta na bincike na Isra'ila-Faransa da aka ƙaddamar a 2017 wanda ya ɗauki hotunan ciyayi da gonaki don bibiyar canje-canjen muhalli.
strings.sat.desc.cat.weather: Tauraron dan wuta na yanayi wanda yake wucewa a saman sandunan duniya. Yana ɗaukar hotunan gizagizai, hadari, da yanayin zafi, kuma bayanansa suna taimakawa hasashen yanayi.
strings.sat.desc.cat.observation: Tauraron dan wuta wanda yake ɗaukar hoton saman Duniya — dazuzzuka, birane, tekuna, da kankara — don bibiyar yadda suke canzawa cikin lokaci.
strings.sat.desc.cat.science: Tauraron dan wuta da aka gina don nazarin sararin samaniya ko Duniya. Wasunsu ba sa aiki yanzu, amma har yanzu suna cikin kewaya.
strings.sat.desc.cat.telescope: Teleskop na sararin samaniya wanda yake duba sararin samaniya daga sama da sararin iska, wanda yake shanye mafi yawan hasken da yake zuwa daga sararin samaniya.
strings.sat.desc.cat.communication: Tauraron dan wuta wanda yake tura talabijin, intanet, da kiran waya. Mafi yawansu suna tashi sama sosai, saboda haka ba za a gan su da ido tsirara ba sai kaɗan daga cikinsu.
strings.sat.desc.cat.starlink: Ɗaya daga cikin dubban tauraron dan wuta na Starlink na SpaceX, wanda yake baiwa intanet daga sararin samaniya. Suna tashi ƙasa, saboda haka sauki ake ganinsu, kuma wani lokaci suna wucewa a cikin layi mai tsawo, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
strings.sat.desc.cat.rocket: Sashin sama na roka, wanda ya kai tauraron wuta zuwa kewayawarsa kuma shi kansa ya rage a can. Waɗannan abubuwa suna da girma kuma galibi suna sheki, saboda haka ganin su yana da sauki kaɗan.
strings.identify.proMore: Pro yana gano kowane tauraro, ƴan tauraro, da abin sararin samaniya mai zurfi shi ma.
strings.moon.asSeen: A kallon kusurwa yadda ake ganin shi daga wurinka · {t}
